data.name: Hanuman
data.gender_notes: Hanuman is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit hanu, 'jaw', + the possessive suffix — 'he who has a (marked) jaw'. Its root is Sanskrit hanu + mant. Hanuman, the devoted monkey-god of the Ramayana. Hanuman is a Sanskrit name meaning “Having a (prominent) jaw”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hanuman expresses “Having a (prominent) jaw”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit hanu, 'jaw', + the possessive suffix — 'he who has a (marked) jaw'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hanuman total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
